cover: A scope worksheet for your first version

slides.title: The question you're testing
slides.body: Will people do this, and pay for it, if it's easy enough? Write your own version of that sentence first.

slides.title: The journey, from problem to value
slides.body: List each step from the user's starting problem to the moment they get value. That journey is the first version.

slides.title: For each feature: needed for the journey?
slides.body: If the journey works without it, it moves to the later list with the reason it's waiting.

slides.title: For each feature that waits
slides.body: Who needs it? What would they do without it? What evidence would bring it back into scope?

slides.title: Foundations the journey needs
slides.body: Sign-in and permissions, storage you can trust, a way to release and roll back. Payments, if payment is part of the test.

slides.title: A new request mid-build
slides.body: Compare it with the journey. If it goes in, write down what it costs: the date, the budget or another feature.
